_comment: Synthetic prophet/index.json exercising the WINDOW ELAPSED vocabulary and the stale-frame action suppression. Two rows on purpose: an overtime plan whose price frame never reconciled, and a fresh triggered plan as the unchanged-render control. The stale row is what the closure contract actually makes reachable — the declared window ran out while the close/current price frame stayed unavailable — so it carries phase='overtime' with recommended_action=null, last_price=null, no what_to_do_now, and a geometry block with no price-derived distances. THE WIRE ENUM IS STILL 'overtime' ON BOTH SHAPES (flat and state.*): the Terminal renames nothing on the wire, it only stops saying 'Overtime' to the reader. Every row is production-shaped — state.geometry, state.components, profit_plan and thesis — because all three surfaces (card, analysis panel, confidence panel) render this fixture and a bare row would let a suppressed block pass as green.
